attchmntText: Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015'.
Arvind Fashions Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Newspaper Publication in connection with the Rights Issue of the Company'.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange that This is further to our letter dated March 18, 2020, intimating issue schedule for the Rights Issue of the Company. Considering the current countrywide lock down imposed by the Government of India to combat the spreading of Novel Coronavirus ( COVID-19 ) and overall market conditions, the Committee of Directors has, at its meeting held on March 26, 2020, decided to defer the Rights Issue of the Company till such time as may be decided by the Board of Directors / Committee of Directors of the Company in the interest of shareholders of the Company.The Company will inform the exchanges and shareholders about any further development in this regard.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'shut-down of Company s stores, offices etc., due to Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19)'.

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange that the Committee of Directors at its meeting held on March 18, 2020, has approved schedule of the Rights Issue and Letter of Offer and Abridged Letter of Offer to be filed with BSE Limited, National Stock Exchange of India Limited and the Securities and Exchange Board of India and to be dispatched to the Eligible Equity Shareholders of the Company as on Record Date.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of transactions in securities by the Promoters and Promoter Group'.

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as March 18, 2020 for the purpose of determining names of the shareholders of the Company eligible to apply for the Equity Shares in the proposed Rights Issue of the Company.

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange that the Committee of Directors at its meeting held on March 12, 2020, has approved the issue of 1, 99,75, 953 Equity Shares of face value of Rs. 4/ �� each at an issue price of Rs . 150/ - per Equity Share (including premium of Rs. 146/ - per Equity Share) aggregating to Rs. 299.64 Crore to all the existing equity shareholders of the Company on a rights basis ("Rights Issue").
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as March 18, 2020 for the purpose of Right issue
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Newspaper advertisement for Notice of Postal Ballot & E-voting'.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Credit Rating

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'This is to inform you that the Board of Directors of Arvind Fashions Limited and Arvind Lifestyle Brands Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company at their meetings held today approved in principle, the transaction as mentioned in the Annexure to the intimation. The details of said Annexure is pursuant to the Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'We are submitting herewith a copy of Public Announcement on addendum cum notice to the eligible Equity Shareholders of Arvind Fashions Limited in connection with the Rights Issue of the Company'.

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated February 11, 2020, titled "Press Release in respect of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and nine months ended on 31.12.2019.".
Arvind Fashions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2019.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018'.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'We are submitting herewith the copy of Public Announcement published in connection with the Rights Issue of the Company in terms Regulation 72(2) of the SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, in the following newspapers on December 20, 2019'.

Significant movement in price has been observed in Arvind Fashions Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Arvind Fashions Limited has submitted their response.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on December 17, 2019.
Arvind Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of the Board Meeting held on December 17, 2019.
